about.title: A balanced approach
about.p1: Fatema interprets dreams with a scholarly method based on Islamic teaching, without exaggeration and without causing fear. We believe dreams are messages from God. Some bring good news and comfort; others bring a warning. We work hard to give a deep and realistic reading of their symbols.
about.p2: This site is for interpreting dreams on sound foundations from the Quran and the Sunnah of the Prophet. It links dream interpretation with calling people to Allah, in a simple and short way.
about.p3: Since I started this work, I have seen that the people most interested in dreams are often the ones facing the hardest trials. So I made episodes about true happiness — being close to Allah — which leads to happiness in the Hereafter.
about.verse: “And who is better in speech than one who calls to Allah, does good, and says: I am one of the Muslims.”
about.bullet1: Over 11 years of interpreting dreams, by God’s grace, based on the Quran and Sunnah.
about.bullet2: A researcher in the science of dream interpretation.

method.title: How we read your dream
method.depth: A deep look at every symbol
method.depthText: We study each symbol in its context, not from a ready-made dream dictionary.
method.honestyText: We say what we see, kindly and with care for your situation.
method.calmText: We do not try to scare you. A dream is a message to understand with a calm heart.
method.contextText: The interpreter may first ask you a question or two, so the meaning is clearer and more accurate.

stats.title: By Allah’s grace, our interpretations match what really happens — as the people who asked us confirm
